data.name: Ayyubiyah
data.gender_notes: Ayyubiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayyubiyah is a name that symbolizes patience, perseverance, and endurance in the face of adversity. The name Ayyubiyah carries the meaning “Patience, perseverance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayyubiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody patience, perseverance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Patience is a virtue that is highly valued in Islam, and those with this name are encouraged to cultivate patience and perseverance in their daily lives.
data.etymology: Ayyubiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Patience, perseverance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayyubiyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أيوبية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من اسم سيدنا أيوب عليه السلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: أيوبية هي اسم مؤنث مشتق من اسم سيدنا أيوب عليه السلام، نبي الله الذي اختبره بالصبر على المرض والبلاء، فصبر واحتسب، وأيوب تعني الصبر والتحمل، والاسم يوحي بالصبر والجلد في مواجهة التحديات والمصاعب، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ایوبیہ
in_urdu.meaning: سیدنا ایوب علیہ السلام سے ماخوذ مؤنث نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایوبیہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو سیدنا ایوب علیہ السلام کے نام سے ماخوذ ہے، جو اللہ کے نبی تھے جنہیں بیماری اور مصائب کا صبر کا امتحان ملا، انھوں نے صبر کیا اور اللہ کی رضا مانی، ایوب نام صبر اور تحمل کے معنی رکھتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں روحانی گہرائیوں کے ساتھ منسلک ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے۔

in_hindi.name: अय्यूबिया
in_hindi.meaning: अय्यूब नाम से व्युत्पन्न स्त्रीलिंग नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अय्यूबिया एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अय्यूब नाम से व्युत्पन्न है, जो पैगंबर अय्यूब का नाम है जिन्हें ईश्वर ने धैर्य और सहनशीलता की परीक्षा के लिए बीमारी और क्लेशों का सामना करना पड़ा, यह नाम धैर्य और दृढ़ता के अर्थों से जुड़ा है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_english.name: Ayyubiyah
in_english.meaning: Feminine name derived from Prophet Ayyub's name
in_english.long_meaning: Ayyubiyah is a feminine name derived from the name of Prophet Ayyub (Job), who was tested by Allah with patience and endurance through illness and hardship. The name signifies patience, perseverance, and spiritual resilience. It is rooted in Arabic etymology and holds significant spiritual and cultural importance across Islamic traditions globally, symbolizing the values of faith and steadfastness.

data.cultural_impact: The Ayyubid Dynasty, named after its founder, Saladin, who took the title "Al-Malik Al-Ayyub" (The Sovereign of Ayyub), was a major Islamic power that emerged in the Middle East in the 12th and 13th centuries. The Ayyubid rulers established a new political and cultural center in Egypt, which contributed significantly to the flourishing of Islamic art, science, and learning. The name Ayyubiyah is therefore associated with a rich and complex history of Islamic achievement and cultural innovation.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the prophet Job (Ayyub in Arabic) is considered a model of unwavering faith and devotion to Allah. The trials and tribulations he endured, including the loss of his family, wealth, and health, are seen as tests of his faith. The name Ayyubiyah thus carries the spiritual significance of resilience and submission to Allah's will, even during the most difficult of times. It serves as a reminder that all trials and hardships, no matter how great, can be endured with the help of Allah's grace and guidance.
